notes: v3.3 - owner-designed print formats (Restaurant > Print Format) + pickup/parcel token + agent self-update. Extract over the agent folder and re-run Install-Service.bat (press Enter to keep your saved token).
_howto: To cut a new agent release: (1) bump AGENT_VERSION in agent.mjs + version in package.json, (2) npm run build:exe (needs @yao-pkg/pkg), (3) host the new .exe where 'url' points (the /api/print-agent/download endpoint serves AGENT_EXE_PATH, or set 'url' to any HTTPS host), (4) put its sha256sum + the new version here, (5) git push. v3.3+ agents auto-update within ~6h. Env vars AGENT_LATEST_VERSION / AGENT_SHA256 / AGENT_DOWNLOAD_URL / AGENT_RELEASE_NOTES override this file if set on the VPS.
